prDraft.title: Fix: chunked() silently drops trailing items when the length is not a multiple of size
prDraft.body:
## Problem
chunked() silently drops trailing items when iterable length is not a multiple of the chunk size, and returns empty list for inputs shorter than size, contrary to docstring stating last chunk may be shorter.
## Fix
The range stop value `len(items) - size + 1` excludes the final partial chunk. Changing it to `len(items)` includes all remaining items as the last, possibly shorter chunk.
## Verification
- `tests/test_chunked_partial.py` fails on the current code (AssertionError: assert [[1, 2], [3, 4]] == [[1, 2], [3, 4], [5]] for the first test, and AssertionError: assert [] == [[1, 2]] for the second.).
- The same test passes with this patch, and the full pytest suite passes.

_Reproduced and verified by executing the tests, generated with ReproPilot (NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory)._
